title: trailboss --json until
description: One JSON object per line while the loop runs: one per round (a check run after a finished turn), plus a line when the failure has to wait to be typed, when a turn ends on a rate limit (and for the check after its reset, which isn't a round), when the loop is paused or resumed (`until pause|resume`), and a last line when it stops between rounds. Every line has every field. The check's output and the message typed are never in the output. Exit code 0 on a pass, 1 otherwise.

round.description: Checks run so far (this line's round, for a round line).

passed.description: Whether the check passed; null on a line that isn't a round (a stop between rounds, or waiting to send).

exit_code.description: The check's exit code; null when not a round, or when it was killed (by a signal, or at its time limit).

timed_out.description: The check ran past --check-timeout and was killed, with everything it started; it counts as a failure. null on a line that isn't a check.

files_changed.description: Whether the session's folder changed since the check before; null when unknown (not a git work tree, or checked before the agent's first turn).

cost_usd.description: Dollars the session has spent since the loop started.

minutes.description: Minutes the loop has run, not counting time paused or waiting for a quota or rate-limit reset.

paused_until.description: The loop waits until this time (seconds since the epoch) before typing: the plan's quota is used up, or (with rate_limited) the turn ended on a rate limit.

rate_limited.description: true when the session's turn ended on a rate limit: not a round. The first such line says how long it waits (paused_until); the second, after the reset, carries the check run then, which doesn't count as a round (round stays as it was). null otherwise.

control.description: paused or resumed: `trailboss until pause|resume` took effect. A paused loop runs no check and types nothing; its time doesn't count toward --max-hours. null otherwise.

waiting_to_send.description: Why the failure isn't typed yet (the agent isn't ready); tried again on every look. Said once per reason.

stopped.description: Why the loop ended, on its last line: passed, max_rounds, max_cost, max_time, same_failure, no_changes, session_ended, check_error or stopped (`trailboss until stop`). null while it goes on.

reason.description: The stop in a person's words.
